_note: Teachers of Sham's distillation network. The owner's only rule (2026-11-17): Sham is our model with our rights, and no one's rights may enter it; any training path is fine while it works. Open-weight models under a permissive licence (Apache-2.0) are teachers whose outputs carry no restriction: class=open, whether we host them (notebook) or call them through a free API. class=owner_export: the owner's own chat-app data export, imported by import_chat_export.py (no live access to the app exists). class=restricted: a source whose terms restrict using its outputs to train a model: used only when owner_approved is true AND the env var SHAM_DISTILL_ALLOW_RESTRICTED lists its id. No keys here: key_env names an environment variable.
